prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square advertising poster for a Viettel TV360 live-reward football giveaway. Centerpiece is a surreal row of five duplicate football fans in Viking helmets and red-blue striped jerseys cheering in a stadium. Include the exact text 'Hò Dô Ta', 'Bóng vào, quà ra', and 'MỞ TV360 SĂN QUÀ NGAY TRONG TRẬN'. Background is a crowded football stadium with field grass and soft haze. Surrounding elements: Viettel telecom logo in the top right, floating red gift/confetti blocks, wrapped present box, and a bottom-left prize display with a TV showing football, a game console, a smartphone, and a white jersey labeled 'WORLD CUP 10'. Technical style: photoreal sports giveaway advertising composite, bright stadium promo lighting, celebratory flare and glossy prize surfaces, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
